intro: ^You approach a shambling man by the apple pile.
^Bites you and then just ignores you? How rude.

c-6: ^You are required to deal with it.

s: ^Why is this man not listening to me?

^"But I hope you know what I'm thinking."
^His glassy dark eyes just stare forward into... nothing.

s: ^"Sir, are you a member of the undead?"

^DC17 con-(Scream and shout at the zombie.) "AGRARIAN! WE NEED TO VOTE AGRARIAN! IF WE DON'T, THE EARTH WILL BE SALTED AND THE LAND WILL BE CURSED! <shake>AGRARIAN</shake>!"

c-5: ^To forsake your voice is to forsake your manhood.
